note: Create one HTTP API tool per entry in Dograh > Tools. URL = base_url + path. Parameters with the name workflow_run_id are Preset Parameters (value {{initial_context.workflow_run_id}}).

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Look up clothing designs and their live size-wise stock. Use whenever the user asks about stock, sizes, a design, or before changing anything. If several designs are returned, ask the user which one.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Design name, colour or SKU as the user said it, e.g. 'blue kurta' or 'KRT-1'

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Optional single size such as S, M, L, XL. Empty for all sizes.

tools.name: daily_sales
tools.description: Today's dispatched units and top designs. Use for 'aaj ki sales'. Takes no parameters.

tools.name: app_status
tools.description: Overall live status: designs, sizes, total stock, low/out-of-stock counts, open alerts, pending orders. No parameters.

tools.name: alerts
tools.description: Open low-stock, out-of-stock and order-shortage alerts, optionally filtered.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional design/SKU/size filter; empty for all

tools.name: reorder
tools.description: What needs to be re-ordered for pending marketplace orders, optionally filtered.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional design/SKU filter; empty for all

tools.name: pending_orders
tools.description: Count of pending order lines/units and the latest batch ids. No parameters.

tools.name: recent_activity
tools.description: Most recent stock changes, optionally for one design.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional design/SKU filter; empty for latest overall

tools.name: prepare_stock_update
tools.description: STEP 1 of changing stock. Does NOT change anything; returns a summary to read to the user and a confirmation_token. Use operation 'add' to increase by a quantity, 'set' for the final total.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: SKU of the exact design (from search_products)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size such as S, M, L, XL

tools.name: prepare_product_create
tools.description: STEP 1 of creating a new design. Does NOT create anything; returns a summary and confirmation_token.

parameters.name: sizes
parameters.description: Sizes separated by spaces or commas, e.g. 'S M L'

tools.name: prepare_dispatch
tools.description: STEP 1 of dispatching a pending order batch. Does NOT dispatch; returns a summary and confirmation_token.

tools.name: confirm_action
tools.description: STEP 2. Applies a prepared change. Call ONLY after the user clearly said yes to the summary you read out, using the exact confirmation_token from the prepare tool. Never call it in the same turn as a prepare tool.

parameters.name: confirmation_token
parameters.description: Exact token returned by the prepare tool
